key_insight: Map2World enables coherent, scalable 3D world generation conditioned on user-defined segment maps (of arbitrary shape and scale) plus text, solving layout and scale inconsistency that limit prior grid-based methods.
problem_solved: Existing 3D world generators are tied to fixed grid layouts and produce inconsistent object scales across large scenes, offering little intuitive user control; Map2World lets users specify scene structure via segment maps while preserving global scale and layout coherence.
method: Condition the generative pipeline on user-provided segment maps and optional text prompts to control semantic layout and style.
Use scale-aware, multi-resolution representations and coordinate-aware conditioning to maintain consistent object sizes and geometry across arbitrary map shapes.
Synthesize geometry and appearance in a hybrid pipeline (local detail + global consistency modules) to produce large, coherent 3D worlds from map + text inputs.
impact: Provides practitioners a practical way to create controllable, large-scale 3D scenes for XR content, simulation, and virtual testing, reducing manual modeling and improving realism and repeatability in procedural world generation.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: segment map + text -> Map2World -> final 3D world (with callouts for scale-aware & global-consistency modules)
Before/after comparison: grid-constrained generation vs. map-conditioned arbitrary-shape generation highlighting layout flexibility
Scale-consistency heatmap or side-by-side object size comparison across long-range scenes
UI mockup showing user-drawn segment map and generated 3D preview (bird's-eye and first-person views)
paper_title: Map2World: Segment Map Conditioned Text to 3D World Generation
paper_authors: Jaeyoung Chung, Suyoung Lee, Jianfeng Xiang, Jiaolong Yang, Kyoung Mu Lee
